reviewItem.question: Does "The option to run a synchronous probe using `cilium-health status --probe` is no longer supported, and is now a hidden option that returns the results of the…" mean a change to cli-flag:cilium|name=--probe|component=cilium-health (behavior-changed)?

change.after: "returns the results of the most recent cached probe"

proposed.statement: The cilium-health status --probe flag no longer runs synchronous probes; it now returns cached results and is hidden, scheduled for removal in a future release.
